headline: Turkey and Netherlands eye offshore wind cooperation ahead of COP31
summary: Turkey and the Netherlands are working toward a declaration of intent to bolster cooperation in offshore wind energy, according to the Dutch Ambassador.
why: International renewable energy partnerships facilitate cross-border clean-tech investments and policy alignment.
